purpose: 2D diagrams that must auto-trace to vector: charts, blueprints, floor plans, schematics. Score = text legibility (OCR exact) + trace fidelity + path economy + axis-alignment + flatness.
note: Frozen before any model runs. Every prompt demands sharp geometry and exact strings, because those are what a tracer can read.

params.style_suffix: , flat 2D vector style, blueprint design, line art, sharp edges, solid monochrome fills, white background, high contrast, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D

prompts.prompt: A vertical flowchart with four rectangular boxes labelled START, VALIDATE, STORE, DONE, connected top to bottom by straight arrows

structure.q: Are there exactly four rectangular boxes?
Are the boxes connected in a single vertical chain by arrows?
Are all lines horizontal or vertical, with no diagonals?

prompts.prompt: A simple two-bedroom apartment floor plan seen from above, thick black walls on a white background, rooms labelled BEDROOM, BEDROOM, BATH, KITCHEN, LIVING, one door gap in each room wall

structure.q: Are the walls drawn as thick straight black lines forming closed rooms?
Are the walls all axis-aligned (horizontal or vertical)?
Is every room labelled with text?

prompts.prompt: A bar chart with four vertical bars of increasing height, an axis line at the bottom, and the labels Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 under the bars

structure.q: Are there exactly four bars?
Do the bars increase in height from left to right?
Are the bars filled with a single solid colour and no gradient?

prompts.prompt: A three-level org chart: one box labelled CEO at the top, two boxes labelled CTO and CFO below it, connected by right-angle connector lines

structure.q: Are there exactly three boxes?
Is the CEO box above the other two?
Are the connectors right-angle lines rather than curves?

prompts.prompt: A simple RC low-pass filter schematic: a resistor symbol labelled R1 in series, a capacitor symbol labelled C1 to ground, input and output terminals, drawn as thin black lines on white

structure.q: Is a resistor symbol drawn as a zigzag or rectangle in series?
Is a capacitor symbol drawn as two parallel plates?
Are the connecting wires straight horizontal or vertical lines?

prompts.prompt: A front-view engineering blueprint of a rectangular metal bracket with two circular mounting holes, dimension lines with arrows, drawn as white lines on a solid dark blue background

structure.q: Is the drawing white on a solid dark blue background?
Are there exactly two circular holes?
Are dimension lines with arrows present?

prompts.prompt: A binary tree diagram with seven circular nodes arranged in three levels, root at the top, connected by straight lines, each node labelled with a number from 1 to 7

structure.q: Are there exactly seven circular nodes?
Are they arranged in three levels with one node at the top?
Are the connectors straight lines?

prompts.prompt: A horizontal timeline with a single straight axis line, four tick marks, and the year labels 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 spaced evenly below the ticks

structure.q: Is the axis a single straight horizontal line?
Are there exactly four tick marks?
Are the labels evenly spaced?

prompts.prompt: A network topology diagram with one central rectangle labelled SERVER connected by straight lines to three smaller rectangles labelled PC1, PC2, PC3, white background, black outlines

structure.q: Is one box central and the other three around it?
Are there three connecting lines?
Are all boxes rectangular with plain outlines?

prompts.prompt: A two-lane swimlane process diagram, lanes labelled REQUESTER and APPROVER as header rows, with three rounded boxes and straight arrows crossing from the top lane to the bottom lane once

structure.q: Are there exactly two horizontal lanes?
Does exactly one arrow cross between the lanes?
Are the lane dividers straight horizontal lines?
